games.title: Neon Cyber Runner 2088
games.shortDescription: Dash, jump, and dodge laser barriers in this synthwave endless runner.
games.fullDescription: Sprint across neo-Tokyo rooftops while evading rogue security drones. Time your high jumps and slide under magnetic beams to rack up the ultimate high score in full retro-futuristic audio.
games.controlsGuide:
Space / Up Arrow: Jump (Double tap for double jump)
Down Arrow: Slide
P: Pause Game

games.title: Voxel Dungeons
games.shortDescription: Procedural voxel dungeon crawler with loot and monsters.
games.fullDescription: Explore subterranean mazes, collect magic weapons, and defeat skeleton kings in real-time isometric perspective.
games.controlsGuide:
WASD: Move
Left Click: Attack
I: Inventory

games.title: Retro Strike 2026
games.shortDescription: Fast arcade shooter with retro synthwave music.
